ValidationRule.description: On-site staff must live within a grade-based radius (120/150/200 miles) of the office.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Office_Location__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Home_Location__latitude__s)), NOT(Is_Remote__c), DISTANCE(Office_Location__c, Home_Location__c, 'mi') > CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Director', 200, 'Principal', 150, 120) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Home location is too far from the office for this work arrangement.
